maps_to: `guide/topics/manifest/data-element` — `.` matches any single character; `*` matches zero or more of the **immediately preceding** character and is greedy; `.*` matches any sequence and is **lazy**; there is **no backtracking**, a single forward pass. Documented non-matches: `"abc.*xyz"` does **not** match `"abcpxqrxyz"`; `"a.*.c"` does **not** match `"abbbc"`; `"a*a"` does **not** match `"aaa"`
